name: gov-emergent-country-default
description: Default theme for emerging-country government portals. Operators are expected to override colors with their national palette.
notes: Replace primary/secondary with national flag colors when deploying for a specific country.
Inter is a free open-source font; replace with national typography preferences if available.
Color contrast respects WCAG 2.1 AA (text on background >= 4.5:1).
